'''Gordon Fraser''' (born 27 November 1943) is a Scottish former professional footballer.  A product of the Scottish Highland Football League, Fraser played as a centre forward in the [[English Football League]] for [[Cardiff City F.C.|Cardiff City]], [[Millwall F.C.|Millwall]], and [[Newport County A.F.C.|Newport County]].  He also played in the Scottish Highland Football League with Forres Mechanics FC, his first senior club, and subsequently with Elgin City on his return from Millwall.
